meta.title: UAP transfer gallery: selected samples of three unseen tasks across budgets
meta.model_config: UAPs trained on the main image set (target layer language_29) applied unchanged; clean and perturbed outputs of the same sample

feature_labels.shopping_relevance: Shopping relevance: relevance of a product image to a shopping query (1-5), Marqo/marqo-GS-10M
feature_labels.moral_evaluation: Moral evaluation: morality of a photographed scene (1-5), AIML-TUDA/smid (SMID)
feature_labels.damage_severity: Damage severity: visible disaster-damage severity (0-2), QCRI/MEDIC

units.label: model label on the task scale; see score_meanings
units.epsilon: L_inf bound in processor-normalised pixel units (valid range [-1, 1]); epsilon_fraction_of_pixel_range = epsilon / 2

meta.aggregation: per-sample model outputs as saved in results/generalisation/<task>/predictions.csv
caveats: The examples are chosen for the size of their shift and are not representative: all_samples_shift_at_ranking_epsilon gives the whole sample.

The budgets are large: epsilon = 1.0 allows a change of half the pixel range and epsilon = 2.0 spans the whole range, so epsilon = 2.0 is not an imperceptible perturbation and should be read as a saturation regime.
Images are published for the shopping task only. For damage severity and moral evaluation the source terms do not allow redistribution; see image_policy.
Published perturbed images are derived from the source image and carry its licence and attribution. Subtracting the clean image recovers the perturbation wherever it is not clipped.
At large budgets the model often describes content that is not in the image, including offensive text; such explanations are model output, not a description of the source image.
No noise baseline: part of any shift may be generic image corruption.

panel_label: Largest observed label shifts in the dominant direction and the largest opposite shift at ε = 1.00; not representative examples

selection_rule.pool: all samples of the frozen task sample whose output parsed in every condition
selection_rule.metric: absolute change in the label at epsilon = 1.00
selection_rule.selection: per task and UAP, the 4 highest-ranked shifts in the dominant direction (sign of the mean shift over all valid samples) and the 1 highest-ranked shift in the opposite direction; if one side has too few, the next-ranked samples fill the set

strong_language.handling: 'text' has strong language reduced to its first letter; 'text_unmasked' is present only where contains_strong_language is true and is meant for a reveal control

image_encoding.content: the model-input tensor (image processor output, plus the perturbation, clamped to [-1, 1]) mapped to 8-bit RGB
